title: What If the World Hit 10 Billion People?
subject: crowded earth

scenes.text: What if the world hit 10 billion people? The UN says it will, and then something odd happens.
Today we're about 8.2 billion. The UN projects a peak near 10.3 billion in the mid-2080s.
After that, it doesn't keep climbing. The UN expects a slight drop to about 10.2 billion by 2100.
Already 63 countries, home to about 28 percent of humanity, have passed their peak.
China, Russia, Japan and Germany are among them. Falling birth rates are the reason.
The peak is also about 700 million lower than the UN projected in 2013. The crowd is peaking sooner.
